description: Frozen recompute task list for the evidence-driven minimum set of historical Proposed evaluations exposed to the v6 shared SCG strong-time repair (static urgency conflict tier).
selection_rule: work/v6_historical_impact/historical_rows_recovered.csv rows with scg_tier == 'A_static_urgency_conflict_detected' (all m in {2,3,4} x j2/k2/w2 configurations); no outcome filtering; task_id = sha256(schema|model_id|L|H|mode).
tier_definition: Tier A: the untimed marking graph has a reachable pair of simultaneously enabled transitions (t,u) with t.earliest > u.latest (finite). This is a necessary-condition exposure screen, not a certificate that the archived verdict changes.

scope_separation.statement: This manifest is an add-on historical recompute; it is disjoint from the formal 8,280-cell v6 matrix, does not consume its budget, and must never be pooled with its results.

recompute_protocol.mode_assumption: The archived Proposed shards carry no mode column. FIRST_CERTIFICATE is the documented archived default and is supported by the archived proposed/reference runtime ratio (median 0.108 for tier A): the Proposed pass stops at the first certificate while the archived reference enumerates completely.

archived.critical_pair_count_source: archived MSCG-LP reference record .terminal_pairs (complete enumeration, v4 semantics); the archived Proposed shard CSV stores no certificate counters
